manifest.description: Per-space package and skill composition (backlog:7543aabbd901, BO-F4-01 Personalizzazione). One row per (space, unit): activating a package or a skill in a space records the composition here; deactivating marks it removed, never deletes history. Read-only publicly: every field is managed, so rows exist only through the package's activate operation.
